Original capture metadata is preserved here; verified_source_snapshots independently hashes the explicitly listed server/src/contract/proof/tools/native source prefixes after checking it against the named Git revision. The baseline benchmark-only metadata helper was adjusted to retain the original revision; no admitted source or emitted C was changed.
